==English==

===Prepositional phrase===
{{en-prepphr}}

# With a substantial number of men capable of [[exerting]] force or of making a [[show of force]].
#: {{ux|en|The police arrived '''in force''' at dawn to raid the [[drug lab]].}}
# With a substantial display of resources.
#: {{ux|en|They made the presentation '''in force''' to try to impress the client.}}
# {{lb|en|law|insurance}} In [[effect]]; [[applicable]].
#: {{syn|en|effective}}
#: {{ux|en|Some of the old laws against treason are no longer '''in force'''.}}
